views.name: trees_income_joined
views.body_sql: SELECT t.idx AS tree_record, t.boroname AS borough, i.Estimate_Median_income AS median_income, i.Estimate_Mean_income AS mean_income FROM trees t LEFT JOIN income_trees i ON t.zipcode = i.zipcode WHERE t.boroname IS NOT NULL AND t.boroname != '' AND i.Estimate_Median_income > 0 AND i.Estimate_Mean_income > 0
views.description: Joins trees and income datasets on ZIP code, filling missing ZIP values, and retains only records with a valid borough name and strictly positive median and mean incomes.

views.name: borough_aggregates
views.body_sql: SELECT borough, COUNT(*) AS total_trees, AVG(mean_income) AS average_mean_income FROM trees_income_joined GROUP BY borough
views.description: Groups the filtered tree records by borough to compute the total number of trees and the average mean income per borough.
